description: Maps benchmark fixtures to existing deterministic offline proof artifact directories in dfm-packets/. Each mapping indicates that the referenced packet directory contains CAM/G-code/simulation proof artifacts that demonstrate the operation types and capabilities needed for that fixture.

fixture-014-face-mill-plate.rationale: proof_face_drill includes face_mill operation on 6061 aluminum with G-code, simulation, and toolpath artifacts. Fixture-014 requires only face_mill + chamfer.

fixture-015-contour-plate.rationale: bracket_with_slots includes face + contour operations with full proof artifacts (G-code, simulation, toolpath). Fixture-015 requires face_mill + contour.

fixture-001-face-drill-plate.rationale: proof_face_drill includes face_mill + drill operations on 6061 aluminum with complete proof artifacts. Fixture-001 requires face_mill + drill + chamfer.

fixture-003-bolt-circle.rationale: proof_face_drill provides face_mill + drill proof, bracket_with_slots provides contour proof. Together they cover fixture-003's face + contour + drill operations on aluminum.

fixture-002-pocket-plate.rationale: pocket_plate includes face_mill + pocket + drill operations on aluminum with G-code, simulation, and toolpath artifacts. Fixture-002 requires face_mill + pocket + drill + chamfer.

fixture-004-slot-chamfer.rationale: bracket_with_slots includes face + pocket/contour + drill operations on aluminum with full proof artifacts. Fixture-004 requires face + slot + drill + chamfer operations on aluminum.

fixture-005-multi-hole-sizes.rationale: proof_face_drill includes face_mill + drill operations on 6061 aluminum. Fixture-005 requires face_mill + multiple drill sizes + chamfer.

fixture-007-tight-tolerance.rationale: pocket_plate includes face + pocket + drill operations on aluminum; demonstrates capability class operations though tolerance class differs.

fixture-008-thin-wall.rationale: pocket_plate includes face + pocket + drill operations on aluminum; demonstrates core operation types though thin-wall-specific simulation not verified.

fixture-013-needs-review-missing-info.rationale: bracket_with_slots includes face + pocket + contour + drill operations on aluminum with full proof artifacts. Fixture-013 requires face + contour + drill + chamfer.

fixture-006-tapped-holes.rationale: proof_tapped_holes is a dedicated DFM packet for face_mill + spot_drill + drill + tap + chamfer operations on 6061 aluminum. Includes G-code with G84 tapping cycles, toolpath with tap cycle segments, simulation/validation artifacts, and CAM plan. Directly covers all operations required by fixture-006.

fixture-009-deep-pocket.rationale: pocket_plate includes face + pocket + drill operations on aluminum with G-code, simulation, and toolpath artifacts. Fixture-009 requires face + pocket + drill on steel; the pocket milling operation is demonstrated by pocket_plate and the steel material difference affects feeds/speeds (documented separately) rather than CAM operation structure.

fixture-010-odd-material-brass.rationale: proof_face_drill includes face_mill + drill operations on 6061 aluminum with complete G-code, simulation, and toolpath artifacts. Fixture-010 requires face_mill + drill on brass; the operations are identical and the material difference is addressed via feeds/speeds tuning rather than different CAM operation types.

fixture-017-multi-depth-pocket.rationale: pocket_plate includes face + pocket + drill operations on aluminum; demonstrates core pocket milling capability though multi-depth aspect is not specifically validated.

fixture-011-two-sided-setup.rationale: bracket_with_slots includes face + pocket + contour + drill operations on 6061 aluminum with full proof artifacts; proof_face_drill provides face + drill operations. Fixture-011 requires face + pocket + drill + contour on aluminum with two-sided setup. Core operation types are demonstrated; two-sided fixturing (soft jaws/fixture plate for second op) is standard practice not separately validated in these packets.

fixture-016-plastic-delrin.rationale: proof_face_drill includes face_mill + drill operations on 6061 aluminum with complete proof artifacts; bracket_with_slots includes face + contour operations. Fixture-016 requires face + drill + contour on Delrin (Acetal) plastic. CAM operation types (face, drill, contour) are identical between aluminum and plastic; material-specific feeds/speeds and sharp-tooling requirements are DFM concerns documented separately.

fixture-018-thin-wall-plastic.rationale: pocket_plate includes face + pocket + drill operations; bracket_with_slots includes face + pocket/contour + drill operations. Fixture-018 requires face + pocket + drill + contour on Delrin (Acetal) plastic with thin-wall (1.8 mm) geometry. Core CAM operations (face, pocket, drill, contour) are demonstrated; thin-wall plastic deflection/chatter risk is addressed via DFM flags and sharp-tooling requirements rather than CAM operation structure.

fixture-020-tight-tolerance-steel.rationale: pocket_plate includes face + pocket + drill operations on aluminum; proof_tapped_holes provides face + drill + tap operations on 6061 aluminum with G84 tapping cycles. Fixture-020 requires face + pocket + drill + bore + tap on 4140 steel with tight tolerance (+/-0.02 mm bore). Core operations (face, pocket, drill, tap) are demonstrated across these packets; precision boring capability for tight-tolerance bore is standard tooling (boring head) not specifically validated; steel material feeds/speeds adjustment is documented separately.
